I-DeSmuME ayisasebenzi futhi izosuswa kwesinye sezibuyekezo ezizayo. Londoloza inqubekelaphambili yakho ngaphakathi kwegeyimu, bese ushintshela ku-melonDS. Ukulondoloza kwegeyimu kuzolayisha ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-melonDS, kodwa izimo zokulondoloza zingasetshenziswa kuphela ne-core eyizidalile.
Ukuze ungeze amafayela e-BIOS, beka amafayela asekelwayo kufolda yakho ye-ROMs bese uskena kabusha. Igama lefayela kufanele lifane ncamashi.

Kukhona okubi juhteka. Zama okulandelayo:
• Khubaza ukonga okuzenzakalelayo bese uqalisa kabusha umdlalo
• Iya kuzilungiselelo ze-Android bese usula inqolobane yohlelo lokusebenza
• Iya kuzilungiselelo ze-Lemuroid bese wenza Ukusetha Kabusha Kwefektri
Uma akukho kulokhu okungenhla okusebenza, kungase kube khona ukuthi lo mdlalo/i-Core ayisekelwa yile divayisi.

Le divayisi ayisekeli isikhethi sefayela se-StorageAccessFramework. Sicela ukopishe mathupha amafayela e-ROM angacindezelwe ku-%1$s bese ucindezela i-Rescan.

Inqubo elindile kusukela kunguqulo yangaphambili ingase ivimbe ukufakwa kwe-ROM. Ungaqhubeka nokulinda noma usule idatha yohlelo lokusebenza ukuze ululame. Amafayela akho e-ROM ngeke asuswe, kodwa uzodinga ukukhetha kabusha ifolda ye-ROM. Uma lokhu kuthatha ngaphezu kwemizuzu emi-5, ukusula idatha yohlelo lokusebenza kuyalulekwa.
Inqubo elindile kusukela kunguqulo yangaphambili ingase ivimbe ukufakwa kwe-ROM. Ungaqhubeka nokulinda noma uvule izilungiselelo ukuze ubuyekeze ukucushwa kwesitoreji sakho.
I-EmulAItor izobuyisa idatha yayo yohlelo lokusebenza manje. Amafayela akho e-ROM ngeke asuswe, kodwa uzodinga ukukhetha kabusha ifolda ye-ROM.

•Mayelana ne-EmulAItor
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luyifolishi yephrojekthi yomthombo ovulekile Lemuroid, esatshalaliswa ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-GPL-3.0.

•Isaziso Esibalulekile
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza alufaki imidlalo futhi alulandi ngokuzenzakalelayo noma yikuphi okuqukethwe. Isici sokuphequlula sibonisa okuqukethwe okutholakala esidlangalaleni ku-Archive.org nemidlalo yamahhala yasekhaya evela ku-itch.io. Umsebenzisi unesibopho sokuqinisekisa amalungelo abo okufinyelela noma ukusebenzisa noma iyiphi i-ROM yemithombo yangaphandle.

•Ngingalisebenzisa kanjani lolu hlelo lokusebenza?
Kopisha amafayela akho e-ROM kufolda kudivayisi yakho bese uyikhetha ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza. Le folda ingaba namafolda angaphansi. Ngemuva kokuthi ukuskena kuqediwe kufanele ubone imidlalo yakho.

•Kungani imidlalo yami ingatholakali?
Uma imidlalo yakho icindezelwe, zama ukuyikhipha. Uma lokhu kungasebenzi, beka ama-ROM kumaifolda ahlukene, eyodwa ohlelo ngalunye olunamafomethi alandelayo: $SYSTEMS.

•Amalayisensi
I-Lemuroid: GPL-3.0 (Swordfish90)
I-LibretroDroid: GPL-3.0
Ama-Cores e-Libretro: Amalayisensi ahlukahlukene

Kubonakala sengathi i-core ye-Libretro ibe nenkinga engalindelekile. Uma iqhubeka sicela uzame okulandelayo:
• Khubaza ukulondoloza okuzenzakalelayo bese uqalisa kabusha umdlalo
• Iya kuzilungiselelo ze-Android bese usula i-cache yohlelo lokusebenza
• Iya kuzilungiselelo ze-Lemuroid bese wenza Ukusetha Kabusha Ifektri
Uma kungekho kulokhu okungenhla okusebenzayo, kungase kube khona ukuthi lo mdlalo/i-Core ayisekelwa yile divayisi.
Isimo sokulondoloza asihambisani nenguqulo yamanje ye-core. Sicela ulayishe ukulondoloza kokugcina okungaphakathi kwegeimu noma usebenzise inguqulo yangaphambili ye-Lemuroid.
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luyingxenye yephrojekthi yomthombo ovulekile i-Lemuroid, esatshalaliswa ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-GPL-3.0.
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza alufaki imidlalo futhi alulandi ngokuzenzakalelayo noma yimaphi amafayela.

Isici sokuphequlula sibonisa okuqukethwe okutholakala esidlangalaleni ku-Archive.org nemidlalo yamahhala yasekhaya evela ku-itch.io. I-EmulAItor ayihambisani nanoma iyiphi insizakalo. Umsebenzisi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqinisekisa amalungelo abo okufinyelela noma ukusebenzisa noma iyiphi i-ROM.
Unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqinisekisa ukuthi unelungelo elisemthethweni lokusebenzisa noma yimaphi amafayela e-ROM ngalolu hlelo lokusebenza.
Ngokuqhubeka, uyakwamukela imigomo yokusebenzisa yalolu hlelo lokusebenza.
Indlela ephelele ifaka phakathi igama lesabelo
Azikho izinsiza ezenziwe ngendlela oyifisayo ezilungiselelwe
Le folda ayikwazi ukwengezwa ngoba i-Android ayinikezwanga ukufinyelela. Khetha enye ifolda.

Ifayela elilandiwe alibonakali liwumdlalo we-ROM ovumelekile walolu hlelo. Umhlinzeki kungenzeka ushicilele ifayela elingalungile noma elingasekelwe. Uma ungawutholi lo mdlalo we-ROM kukhathalogu, ungawulanda mathupha bese uwengeza kufolda yakho ye-ROM.

Ukuhanjiswa okuzenzakalelayo kwama-ROM akutholakali kumalayibrari enethiwekhi (SMB)

1. Khetha ifolda yokugcina ama-ROM akho kusuka kokuthi Izilungiselelo → Isiqondisi.

2. Kopisha amafayela akho e-ROM kuleyo folda.

3. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzoskena ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi lubonise imidlalo yakho esikrinini sasekhaya.

Isigaba se-Catalog sikuvumela ukuthi uhlole amaqoqo ama-ROM avela emithonjeni eminingi yomphakathi:

• Archive.org: Amaqoqo amakhulu ama-ROM akudala.
• itch.io: Imidlalo yamahhala ye-homebrew (idinga ukhiye we-API wamahhala).

• Phequlula ngohlelo noma sesha imidlalo ethile.
• Thepha kumdlalo ukuze uwulande kufolda yakho yama-ROM.
• Imidlalo elandiwe izovela ngokuzenzakalelayo kulayibrari yakho.

Xhuma isilawuli se-Bluetooth noma se-USB bese uya kokuthi Izilungiselelo → Izilungiselelo zesilawuli.

• Khetha isilawuli sakho ohlwini.
• Mapha izinkinobho ngokwezintandokazi zakho.
• Nika amandla ukudlidliza uma isilawuli sakho sikusekela lokho.

Ezinye izinhlelo (PlayStation, Game Boy Advance, njll.) zidinga amafayela e-BIOS ukuze zisebenze.

• Iya kokuthi Izilungiselelo → Ulwazi lwe-BIOS ukuze ubone ukuthi yimaphi amafayela owadingayo.
• Beka amafayela e-BIOS kufolda efanayo nama-ROM akho.
• Igama lefayela kufanele lifane ncamashi nalokho okudingekayo.

Ukulondoloza okuzenzakalelayo kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

• Uma uphuma emdlalweni, inqubekelaphambili yakho ilondolozwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
• Uma uvula umdlalo futhi, uzoqhubeka lapho ugcine khona.
• Ungasebenzisa futhi uhlelo lokulondoloza lomdlalo uqobo (imenyu yangaphakathi komdlalo).

Ungavumelanisa imidlalo yakho elondoloziwe ne-Google Drive.

• Iya kokuthi Izilungiselelo → Vumelanisa Ukulondoloza.
• Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti yakho ye-Google.
• Okulondoloziwe kwakho kuzovumelanisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuwo wonke amadivayisi.

Ukuze ufinyelele imenyu ngesikhathi somdlalo:

• Cindezela inkinobho yemenyu (☰) noma swayipha usuka emaphethelweni esikrini.
• Ukusuka lapho unga: londoloza/layisha izimo, shintsha indawo yokulondoloza, finyelela izinketho ezisheshayo, noma uphume emdlalweni.

⚠️ Lolu hlu luxhuma ezinqolobaneni zomphakathi (Archive.org ne-itch.io) ezingahlobene ne-EmulAItor. Okuqukethwe kwamahhala kwe-homebrew kuphela okufakwe ohlwini kusuka ku-itch.io. Ukusetshenziswa, ukulanda kanye nokuba nalolu hlobo lwempahla kuwumthwalo womsebenzisi kuphela. 🧠 Nakuba i-EmulAItor ihlunga amafayela ngobuhlakani, kungase kube nezixhumanisi eziphukile, amafayela angahambisani noma okuqukethwe okungewona ama-ROM.

Ukuze ulande imidlalo yamahhala ye-homebrew ku-itch.io, udinga ukhiye we-API: 1. Iya ku-itch.io bese udala i-akhawunti yamahhala 2. Iya ku-Izilungiselelo → Okhiye be-API 3. Khiqiza ukhiye omusha bese uwukopisha 4. Wunamathisele ngezansi

I-itch.io ayinakho okuqukethwe kwe-homebrew kulesi simiso. Zama i-NES, SNES, GBA, GBC noma i-Genesis.

Isikhathi sesilingo samahhala sesiphelile. Ukuze uqhubeke, khetha okukodwa kwalokhu okulandelayo.
Uma uthenge i-EmulAItor ngaphambi kokuba ibe mahhala, faka i-ID yakho ye-oda le-Google Play (GPA...) ukuze ubuyisele ukufinyelela kwakho.
Inketho A: Sesha okuthi \"Google Play Receipt EmulAItor\" ku-Gmail yakho.
Inketho B: Iya ku-pay.google.com, hlola uMsebenzi wakho (Activity), bese ufuna i-EmulAItor.
Ikhodi ye-GPA ayivumelekile noma isivele isetshenzisiwe.
Le khodi isivele isetshenziswa enanini eliphezulu lamadivayisi avunyelwe. Sicela uthenge ilayisense entsha kusuka kokukhethwa kukho okungenhla.
Iphutha lenethiwekhi. Sicela uhlole ukuxhumana kwakho.
